_doc: The games on the store page (the published root, cachedBuilds/index.html), in this order. Every cached build is still listed on /all/. A game shows here once it has a cached build; its tile uses games/<id>/icon/icon.png (square) — without one, its first letter. `names` is each game's shown name on both pages (default: the id, capitalised). Regenerate the pages with `npm run pages` (builds do it too).
